opening: I have a lump in my neck.
It's a dry cough; nothing comes up.
It comes in severe coughing fits.
The coughing fits sometimes make me throw up.
My voice goes hoarse on and off.

opening.text: I have a lump in my neck and a cough. Both started about 4 weeks ago. It's a dry cough; nothing comes up, but it comes in severe coughing fits. Those fits sometimes make me throw up. Also, my voice goes hoarse on and off.
